title: ZPA Private Service Edge Release Summary (2021)

blocks.text: This article provides a summary of all new features and enhancements released per Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) Private Service Edge version.
This ZPA Private Service Edge version includes a fix to address an issue where using multiple IdPs with one entity ID being a substring of the other would configure an incorrect IdP for the user.

Your ZPA Private Service Edge will be updated based on your software update schedule as configured per ZPA Private Service Edge group. To learn more, see About ZPA Private Service Edge Software Upgrades.
This ZPA Private Service Edge version includes the following update:

blocks.item: An update was released for ZPA Private Service Edges that allows the reporting of CPU steal time from the VM by a Hypervisor.

blocks.text: Your ZPA Private Service Edge will be updated based on your software update schedule as configured per ZPA Private Service Edge group. To learn more, see About ZPA Private Service Edge Software Upgrades.
This ZPA Private Service Edge version includes a fix to address an issue where terminating existing ZPA Microtunnels (M-Tunnels) on timeout causes interrupted connections.

Your ZPA Private Service Edge will be updated based on your software update schedule as configured per ZPA Private Service Edge group. To learn more, see About ZPA Private Service Edge Software Upgrades.
This ZPA Private Service Edge version includes a fix to address an issue where the policy would fail to load for the customer if they never connected to the ZPA Public Service Edge.

Your ZPA Private Service Edge will be updated based on your software update schedule as configured per ZPA Private Service Edge group. To learn more, see About ZPA Private Service Edge Software Upgrades.
This ZPA Private Service Edge version includes the following updates:

blocks.item: An update was made that supports the termination of existing ZPA Microtunnels (M-Tunnels) in preparation for functionality changes.
An update was released for ZPA Public Service Edges and ZPA Private Service Edges to support geofencing at a sub-cloud level.

blocks.item: ZPA Private Service Edges now support SCIM for policies. To learn more, see About ZPA Private Service Edges.

blocks.item: ZPA Private Service Edges now support Machine Tunnels. To learn more, see About Machine Tunnels.
